olivia: Quick heads-up — Private/VPC on-prem package is GA in EU-North-1 and AWS GovCloud starting today. :tada: Docs and rollout details below.

michael: Awesome! Is there a matrix for hardware footprints and recommended capacity?

olivia: Yes — see the migration checklist in the doc link I dropped. Short version: 8xA10G for medium clusters, 32xA100/4xH100 for heavy inference. We included sample autoscale policies. https://redwood.internal/docs/private-ga

tara: Security note: KMS/HSM integrations are live. We added FIPS-140 guidance and an audit-log retention toggle in Console. Customers can push logs to their S3 or our SIEM connector.

sam: Can sales get a one-pager for compliance asks (SOC2, ISO)? We have a handful of pilots that need this for procurement.

jess: I’ll create a customer readiness checklist + sales one-pager today. Will tag legal for SOC2 language.

michael: Deploy-bot: starting rollout to EU-North-1 private control-plane cluster now.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout initiated for private-controlplane-eu-north-1 v1.0.0 -> 6 nodes. ETA ~15m.

olivia: Release notes highlights:
- private control plane with single-tenant option
- customer-managed networking (VPC peering + Transit Gateway guide)
- KMS/HSM support + key rotation docs
- audit log streaming and retention controls
- on-prem installer (air-gapped) v0.9 (beta)

tara: Heads-up for support/ops: we enabled verbose audit events for control-plane actions for first 72 hours in GA. Log volume might spike. Please watch storage and alert thresholds.

sam: tagging @account-ops for customers on pilot. Will share the one-pager when ready.

jess: Also prepping two customer migration workshops next Tue/Wed — invite sent to Solutions and SEs.

michael: Rollout completed for EU-North-1. No errors in preflight.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout completed successfully (6/6 nodes).

olivia: Thanks team. Action items: jess -> sales one-pager, tara -> confirm audit retention defaults, michael -> post the autoscale sample policy in eng-docs. I'll coordinate a brief exec update later today. :thumbsup:
